text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Push-response pipeline > token backlog threshold. p95 token latency 2.1s -> 2.8s over last 10m, ingestion RPS steady, error rate 4.8% :warning:

eve: I'm paged, looking. any customer-facing impact yet?

sam: seeing elevated connection churn on US-W gateway, streaming sessions piling up. suspect backlog on gateway->mux path.

lee: customer success — we have 3 customers seeing partial stream drops, holding for final token. Not full errors yet, but UX broken.

sam: plan: enter gateway safemode to suppress streaming (keep polling fallback). This is reversible and targets push frames only. low-risk for data loss.

ale: can we apply rate shaping instead? what's safer?

sam: rate shaping won't drain existing KV caches; suppression reduces concurrent open frames and should relieve CPU on gateway. short window (~10-20m) then observe.

alice: ready to flip. command: ```gwctl set-mode --target=push-responses --mode=suppress --reason="backlog-1765432109"```

ops-bot: action queued by alice. executing...

ops-bot: completed: gwctl set-mode (target=push-responses) -> suppress. rollout 100% US-W and US-E in 30s.

ryan: pushed quick client advisory draft for docs: "Temporary streaming suppression active: clients will receive final chunk then connection may close; polling is unaffected. ETA 20m." Link: https://go/internal/status/17654321

maria: publishing status page now and notifying top 5 impacted customers via CSM. cc @lee.

sam: metrics after flip: p95 token latency dropped from 2.8s -> 0.9s within 45s. open streaming sessions down 72%. error rate trending down.

ee: nice. continue to monitor for 15m, then we can try partial reopen with 10% rollouts.

oncall-next: taking monitoring for the next shift. please leave notes on rollback criteria.

sam: rollback criteria: sustained p95 < 1.1s and error rate < 1.0% for 10m, and no new backlog growth. otherwise extend suppression or try staged reopen.

lee: CSM update sent. customers asked for ETA; promised 20-30m and will follow up.

maria: posting short customer-facing line to status: "We temporarily suppressed streaming responses to stabilize latency; polling remains available. We are monitoring and will restore streaming when stable."

sam: continuing to watch. leaving runbook entry: "incident 1765432109 - gw safemode suppress push" with timestamps and commands used.

oncall-next: acknowledged — will pick up in 15m and escalate if metrics regress. :pager:
